three_critical_findings.title: Live outbox latency is per-second granularity due to MySQL TIMESTAMP precision
three_critical_findings.evidence: Phase 2 measurement shows dispatched_lat=1000ms for all events; (dispatched_at - occurred_at) computed in whole seconds because MySQL TIMESTAMP type stores seconds, not microseconds. avg latency from raw TIMESTAMPDIFF in microseconds across 24h gives 333-833ms range.
three_critical_findings.impact: Observability dashboards reporting outbox p99 latency may show 1000ms for events that actually dispatched in <1s wall-clock. SLO `outbox_dispatch_latency_p95 < 2s` is healthy but visualization granularity is coarse.
three_critical_findings.recommendation: If finer SLI desired, migrate domain_events.occurred_at + dispatched_at to TIMESTAMP(3) or TIMESTAMP(6). NOT a V1 blocker — current granularity already proves <1s for all events.

three_critical_findings.title: Audit chain extension is correctly gated to OrderService — direct event() emits do NOT extend audit_logs
three_critical_findings.evidence: Phase 3 cross-flow synthetic test: emitting OrderCreated + OrderStatusChanged directly via event() → audit_logs count=62 → 62, last_hash unchanged.
three_critical_findings.impact: POSITIVE — this is the correct behavior. NF525 audit chain integrity REQUIRES that audit writes flow ONLY through AuditLogService (via the OrderService → FiscalSequenceService → AuditLogService → DB trigger guarded path). Synthetic test bypasses cannot tamper with the chain.
three_critical_findings.recommendation: None. Documented here so future agents do not misinterpret 'audit_growth=0' in synthetic tests as a sync regression.

three_critical_findings.title: Catalog/menu cache key SSOT verified — `kiosk.menu.branch.{id}` NOT `catalog.v15.branch.{id}`
three_critical_findings.evidence: Phase 4 cache invalidation chain test initially used wrong key name (catalog.v15.branch.1) which is for a DIFFERENT cache layer. The kiosk menu cache invalidated by ItemUpdated is `kiosk.menu.branch.1` per InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange::CACHE_KEY_PREFIX. Both branch-scoped + fan-out (branchId=null) variants verified.
three_critical_findings.impact: Sync layer is consistent. The note exists to prevent future agents from probing the wrong key and reporting false-negative regressions.
three_critical_findings.recommendation: Consider grep-friendly comment in InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange.php documenting the SSOT key prefix. NOT a V1 blocker.
